Thiên văn học ban đầu phục vụ đo thời gi: Astronomy originally served to measure time, seasons, and orientation. The scientific turning point comes when the model must make testable predictions: planetary positions, eclipse times or comet orbits. From Galileo's optical telescopes to radio telescopes and space observatories, each tool opens a further wavelength window and reveals celestial objects invisible to the human eye.
Nhà thiên văn không chỉ chụp ảnh. Họ đo: Astronomers don't just take pictures. They measured position, brightness, spectrum and variation over time, then used physics to deduce temperature, chemical composition, velocity and mass. Big data, image sensors and signal processing techniques developed for astronomy then went into medicine, telecommunications, positioning and Earth observation.
Địa chỉ vũ trụ của chúng ta có nhiều tần: Our cosmic address has many layers: Earth, the Solar System, the Orion branch of the Milky Way, the Local Group and the cosmic web. Light from the Sun takes about eight minutes to reach Earth, while light from distant galaxies can travel billions of years. Therefore, the telescope is also a machine that looks back in time.
Trái Đất quay một vòng so với các sao tr: The Earth rotates around the stars in about 23 hours and 56 minutes, and the average solar day is 24 hours long because the Earth simultaneously moves in orbit. The axis of rotation points near the North Star, so in the Northern Hemisphere, the stars seem to rotate around this point. The specific rising and setting directions change according to the observed latitude.
Mùa không do Trái Đất gần hay xa Mặt Trờ: Seasons are not due to the Earth's proximity or distance from the Sun, but mainly due to the axis tilting about 23.4°. When one hemisphere is tilted toward the Sun, the rays are more direct and the days are longer. At the same time, the other hemisphere receives oblique sunlight and has short days, so the two hemispheres have opposite seasons.
Nhật thực đòi hỏi Mặt Trời, Mặt Trăng và: A solar eclipse requires the Sun, Moon and Earth to be nearly aligned at the new moon; A lunar eclipse occurs near a full moon. The Moon's orbit is tilted about 5° compared to the Earth's orbital plane, so not every month is real. Absolutely do not look directly at the Sun without a filter that meets ISO 12312-2 standards.
Các đường biên chòm sao hiện đại giống đ: Modern constellation boundaries are like those on a map: they divide the entire celestial sphere into 88 non-overlapping regions. The figure of the hunter Orion or the scorpion Scorpius is a product of culture and perspective; Two stars that appear next to each other can be very different distances from Earth.
Mười hai chòm Hoàng đạo nổi tiếng vì đườ: The twelve constellations of the Zodiac are famous because the apparent path of the Sun passes through them, but the sidereal Zodiac also crosses the region of Ophiuchus. The IAU's list of 88 constellations includes those with good visibility from only one hemisphere. Because the Earth moves around the Sun, the prominent sky at 9 p.m. changes gradually with the seasons.
Muốn tìm chòm sao, hãy bắt đầu bằng mốc: To find a constellation, start with a bright landmark like Orion, the Southern Cross or the Big Dipper, then use "star hopping" to reach a fainter target. The map must be set to the correct date, time, location and direction. Give your eyes 20–30 minutes to adjust to the dark and use a red light to help see more faint stars.
Năm chí tuyến dài xấp xỉ 365,2422 ngày,: The tropical year is approximately 365.2422 days long, not an integer. The Gregorian calendar distributes leap days to an average length of 365.2425 days, so that the spring equinox passes only very slowly through the centuries. A calendar date is based on the Earth's rotation, while time zones are social conventions to synchronize activities.
Một tuần trăng giao hội dài khoảng 29,53: A lunar conjunction is about 29.5306 days long, so the lunar month has 29 or 30 days. The twelve lunar months are only about 354 days, nearly 11 days shorter than the seasonal year. The lunisolar calendar inserts leap months so that months and seasons are not far apart.
Quy tắc Gregorian: năm chia hết cho 4 là: Gregorian rule: years divisible by 4 are leaps, except for full century years which must be divisible by 400. So 2000 is a leap but 2100 is not a leap. The lunisolar calendar's leap month is determined by the movement of the Sun and the central gases, not by a simple fixed three-year cycle.
Hai mươi bốn tiết khí chia hoàng đạo thà: Twenty-four solar terms divide the zodiac into 15° signs. Markers such as the spring equinox, summer solstice, autumn equinox, and winter solstice reflect Sun–Earth geometry; Traditional agricultural calendar names also depend on regional climate, so it is not possible to predict the weather for all locations.
Bước sóng càng ngắn thì tần số và năng l: The shorter the wavelength, the higher the photon frequency and energy. The atmosphere is transparent to visible light and some radio waves but absorbs many X, gamma and ultraviolet rays, so telescopes in these ranges often have to be placed on satellites. Multi-wavelength observations reveal different physical layers of the same celestial body.
Phổ liên tục thường liên quan vật chất n: Continuous spectra are often associated with hot, dense matter; Emission spectrum appears when dilute gas emits at characteristic wavelengths; The absorption spectrum forms when light passes through a layer of cooler gas. Each element leaves a set of lines like a fingerprint. The width, intensity and displacement of the line also reveal temperature, density and motion.
Hiệu ứng Doppler làm vạch phổ dịch xanh: The Doppler effect causes spectral lines to shift blue when the source approaches and red shift when the source moves away. No matter or information travels faster than light in a vacuum according to the theory of relativity. The distance of one light year is approximately 9.46 trillion km, which is more convenient than kilometers when talking about stars.
Định luật nghịch đảo bình phương cho biế: The inverse square law states that force decreases rapidly with distance, but gravity has an infinite range and always attracts. An object in orbit is essentially falling continuously: the horizontal velocity causes the planet's surface to curve away at the same time the object falls. Equivalent inertial and gravitational masses are the foundation of the equivalence principle.
Trong tương đối rộng, vật chất–năng lượn: In general relativity, matter–energy curves spacetime and objects move along natural paths within that geometry. The theory explains Mercury's orbit, gravitational lensing, gravitational waves, and clock slowing in strong fields. GPS must correct for both narrow and broad relativistic effects.
Hấp dẫn khuếch đại những chênh lệch mật: Gravity amplified small density differences in the early universe, creating the later network of galaxies. In stars, gravity compresses matter while thermal and quantum pressures resist contraction. Disruption of the balance can lead to the formation of stars, supernovae, neutron stars or black holes.
Mặt Trời chứa hơn 99% khối lượng Hệ Mặt: The Sun contains more than 99% of the mass of the Solar System. Four small, rocky inner planets; four larger exoplanets, including two gas giants and two ice giants. The asteroid belt lies between Mars and Jupiter, and the Kuiper belt lies beyond Neptune.
Hành tinh và vệ tinh rất đa dạng: Kim ti: Planets and satellites are very diverse: Venus is hot due to the strong greenhouse effect, Earth has a surface ocean, Jupiter has a large magnetic field, Saturn has a clear ring system. Satellites like Europa and Enceladus have signs of subglacial oceans, making them important targets in the search for habitable environments.
Sao chổi phát triển đầu coma và đuôi khi: Comets develop comas and tails as they approach the Sun; The tail is always pushed in the direction away from the Sun by the solar wind and radiation. A meteorite is a piece that has reached the ground, while a meteoroid is a small object in space and a meteor is a streak of light in the atmosphere. Classification based on trajectory, structure and dynamic state.

Energy generated in the core passes through the radiation zone and then the convection zone before exiting the photosphere. The sunspot is cooler than the surrounding area and associated with a strong magnetic field; The average operating cycle is about 11 years.
Bức xạ nhìn thấy cung cấp năng lượng cho: Visible radiation powers photosynthesis, while infrared contributes to warming. The right distance is only part of the equation: the atmosphere regulates heat, the ozone layer reduces ultraviolet rays, and the magnetosphere deflects many charged particles. Strong solar storms can affect satellites, radio and power grids.
Vùng có thể ở được là khoảng cách cho ph: The habitable zone is the distance that allows liquid water on the surface under certain assumptions, not a guarantee of life. The host star, atmosphere, geology, water, chemical elements, and orbital stability are all important. Potential biomarkers must be tested to rule out non-biological origins.
Các quỹ đạo thực là bài toán nhiều vật t: Real orbits are many-body problems, but the Kepler ellipsoid is a very good approximation when one mass dominates. The semi-major axis describes the orbital size, eccentricity describes the shape, and inclination describes the orbital plane. A circular orbit is just a special case of an ellipse.
Định luật diện tích bằng nhau thể hiện b: The law of equal areas demonstrates conservation of angular momentum: the planet speeds up at perihelion and slows down at aphelion. The period law allows orbit sizes to be compared without tracking the entire path. Newton later pointed out Kepler's three laws as a consequence of gravity.
Tương tác mạnh giữ quark trong proton, n: Strong interactions keep quarks in protons and neutrons and contribute to nuclear binding; Electromagnetic interactions govern atoms, chemistry, and light; weak interaction participates in beta decay and intrastellar reactions; Gravity is weakest at the particle level but dominates large celestial bodies because it always adds up.
Matter is usually made of quarks and leptons. Protons consist of two up quarks and one down quark, neutrons consist of one up and two down; electrons are leptons. Bosons carry interactions, like photons of electromagnetism and gluons of the strong interaction. The Higgs boson is involved in the mechanism for many elementary particles with mass.
Vật chất tối không phát hay hấp thụ ánh: Dark matter does not emit or absorb light significantly but exhibits gravity: galactic rotation curves, galaxy cluster motions, lenses and large structures. It is different from dark energy, the concept used to describe accelerated expansion. The microscopic identity of both remains an open question.
Biểu đồ Hertzsprung–Russell sắp sao theo: Hertzsprung–Russell diagram of stars by luminosity and temperature, showing main sequence, giant stars, and white dwarfs. Massive stars are hot and bright but consume fuel quickly so they live short lives. Initial mass, chemical composition and binary interactions together influence the evolutionary path.
Mây phân tử lạnh co lại và phân mảnh thà: Cold molecular clouds contract and fragment into protostars. Angular momentum creates an accretion disk, from which planets can form. When the core temperature is high enough for sustained hydrogen fusion, pressure gravitationally equilibrates and the star enters the main sequence.
Khi cạn hydro lõi, sao giống Mặt Trời ph: When it runs out of core hydrogen, the Sun-like star swells into a red giant, pushing its outer layers into a planetary nebula and leaving behind a white dwarf. Massive stars fuse up to iron and then their core collapses, possibly leaving a neutron star or black hole. The outcome depends on the mass of the core and the amount of matter lost.
Supernova lõi sụp đổ tạo sóng xung kích: Supernova core collapse creates shock waves and disperses heavy elements. Type Ia supernovas involve white dwarfs in binary systems and have a normalized luminosity useful for measuring distance. The explosive remnants continue to accelerate particles and enrich interstellar gas for new generations.

Bên ngoài chân trời, lỗ đen hút hấp dẫn: Beyond the horizon, black holes gravitationally attract all objects of the same mass. Lỗ sâu là nghiệm hình học giả thuyết có: Wormholes are hypothetical geometric solutions that could connect two regions of spacetime but often require physical conditions that are unknown to exist.
